# Online Shopping System Advanced — business scope

> **What this is.** How this business works, and what the software is being asked to do about it — written for a sponsor, a client or a head of operations. There is no technology in this document on purpose. It is agreed first, and the technical specification is written against it.

## In short

**Online Shopping System Advanced**. What it wants from this: enhanced customer shopping experience.

It is used by two groups of people: members of the public and online shoppers and reviewers.

Nine business processes are in scope, two of them written out step by step: somebody inside the business can run it day to day, there is a record of who did what, people sign in to their own account and money is taken and accounted for, and five more.

Between them they raise **five business decisions** that nobody has settled. Each is listed under the process that forces it, and each is a question only the business can answer — an assumed answer is a defect that surfaces during the build, usually as rework.

Those processes are held in by one rule and two constraints, set out below.

Success is judged on one measure: no finding on an audit of how regulated data is handled.

**Deliberately out of scope:** no support for offline retail operations.

**This is not finished.** Two lines still carry a `{{PLACEHOLDER}}`. An empty section here is a gap, not a section that did not apply.

This document has been marked **agreed**, and the technical specification is written against it.

# The business

*What this is for, and who it is for.*

## Business outcomes

*The outcome the business wants. Not a feature — the reason a feature would be worth building.*

What the business wants: enhanced customer shopping experience.

Everything below is judged against those; a feature that serves none of them is a feature worth arguing about.

| Ref | Outcome | Priority | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BIZ-OUT-01` | **Enhanced customer shopping experience**<br>The main objective of this business is to provide an advanced online shopping experience that not only replicates the efficiency of in-store purchasing but also adds value through digital convenience and innovations. This means user-friendly interfaces, quick and accurate information retrieval, and seamless checkout processes. Enhancing the shopping experience involves adding wishlist capabilities, streamlined order listings, and review functionalities to ensure customer engagement and satisfaction.<br><br>*From your scope:* “Updated project with extra Features like WISHLIST, List Orders, add Reviews, updated routing, resolved search bug is available for Premium.” | Must have | Recommended, accepted |

## People and organisations involved

*Roles and organisations, not named individuals. The group left out of this list is the group the software will not work for.*

These people and organisations touch this: members of the public and online shoppers and reviewers.

Each of them has to be able to do their part of the processes below; a group named here and absent from those is a gap in one or the other.

| Ref | Group | Priority | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BIZ-AUD-01` | **Members of the public**<br>Anybody who arrives without an account, whose intent and technical confidence cannot be assumed. | Must have | Recommended, accepted |
| `BIZ-AUD-02` | **Online shoppers and reviewers**<br>The primary audience consists of individuals who engage regularly in online shopping activities, including browsing, purchasing, and reviewing products. These are tech-savvy individuals looking for a convenient, efficient, and enjoyable online shopping experience. Additionally, the platform caters to reviewers who are essential for providing feedback and enhancing the credibility of the products sold.<br><br>*From your scope:* “Updated project with extra Features like WISHLIST, List Orders, add Reviews.” | Must have | Recommended, accepted |

# How the business runs

*The processes it runs, the rules they obey, what it keeps track of, and what somebody watches.*

## How the work flows

*Who does what, in what order, and what decides. This is the heart of a business scope and the section a feature list cannot replace.*

These are the processes the business runs: somebody inside the business can run it day to day, there is a record of who did what, people sign in to their own account, money is taken and accounted for, what somebody may do depends on their role and people can find what they are looking for, and three more.

Each is set out as the steps the work actually goes through, then the decisions it forces. The technical specification turns every one of them into data, flows, interfaces and tests.

### `BIZ-PRO-01` Somebody inside the business can run it day to day

Without a developer. The back office is a real user group.

*Must have · Recommended, accepted*

### `BIZ-PRO-02` There is a record of who did what

What must be reconstructable later, and how far back.

*Must have · Recommended, accepted*

### `BIZ-PRO-03` People sign in to their own account

Who they are is known, so what they see and do can depend on it.

*Must have · Recommended, accepted*

### `BIZ-PRO-04` Money is taken and accounted for

Including refunds, failures, and what the customer sees.

*Must have · Recommended, accepted*

### `BIZ-PRO-05` What somebody may do depends on their role

Name the roles in business terms and what each may not do.

*Must have · Recommended, accepted*

### `BIZ-PRO-06` People can find what they are looking for

Across what, and what they are allowed to find.

*Must have · Recommended, accepted*

### `BIZ-PRO-07` Somebody new can get started on their own

Without a person setting them up, if that is what is wanted.

*Must have · Recommended, accepted*

### `BIZ-PRO-08` Somebody asks what we hold about them, or asks us to delete it

A legal obligation with a clock on it, and a process almost no scope remembers until the first request arrives.

**How it goes**

1. The request arrives and the person is identified
2. What is held about them is found, across everywhere it is held
3. It is supplied, corrected or removed
4. The response is recorded as evidence

**Decisions this forces** — each one is `DECISION REQUIRED` until somebody answers it.

- Who owns this, and what is the deadline?
- What may be refused, and on what grounds?
- What must be kept even after a deletion request?

*Must have · Recommended, accepted*

### `BIZ-PRO-09` Order fulfillment from checkout to delivery

Once a customer places an order, the business needs to ensure the order is processed seamlessly from checkout to delivery. This includes confirming the order, preparing the items, packaging, dispatching, and delivering to the customer's location. Efficient handling of this process is critical to maintaining customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

**How it goes**

1. Customer checks out with their selected items
2. Order is confirmed with the customer
3. Items are picked and prepared for delivery
4. Items are packaged securely
5. Dispatched with a carrier service
6. Tracked and delivered to the customer

**Decisions this forces** — each one is `DECISION REQUIRED` until somebody answers it.

- What carriers will be used for delivery?
- What is the process for handling lost or damaged goods during delivery?

*Must have · Recommended, accepted*

*Policies, limits, thresholds and who may override them. Every rule here becomes something the build has to enforce.*

|---|---|---|---|
| `BIZ-RUL-01` | **All transactions must be recorded and verified**<br>Each transaction conducted via the platform must be accurately recorded, ensuring both the buyer and the company maintain clear and accurate records of sales. This is crucial for financial reporting and auditing purposes, ensuring transparency and accountability in all business dealings.<br><br>*From your scope:* “Money is taken and accounted for.” | Must have | Recommended, accepted |

## Constraints

*The limits the solution has to live inside, whoever would prefer otherwise.*

What the solution has to live inside: regulated or personal data is held, so the law applies and adherence to data protection laws.

These are not preferences, and the build cannot negotiate them away.

| Ref | Constraint | Priority | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BIZ-CON-01` | **Regulated or personal data is held, so the law applies**<br>{{REGULATION}} governs what may be collected, how long it is kept, who may see it and what happens when somebody asks for it to be removed. Name the regulation — the technical half writes controls against whatever this says. | Must have | Recommended, accepted |
| `BIZ-CON-02` | **Adherence to data protection laws**<br>The platform must operate in compliance with all applicable data protection laws and regulations. This includes ensuring customer data is stored securely, used appropriately, and not shared without consent. Regular audits should be conducted to verify compliance.<br><br>*From your scope:* “Constraint: Regulated or personal data is held, so the law applies.” | Must have | Recommended, accepted |

*The cheapest section to write and the most expensive one to leave empty.*

> # Installation
>
> 1. Install XAMPP or WAMPP.
>
> 2. Open XAMPP Control panal and start [apache] and [mysql] .
>
> 3. Download project from github(https://github.com/PuneethReddyHC/online-shopping-system-with-advanced-admin-page.git)  
>     OR follow gitbash commands
>
>     i>cd C:\\xampp\htdocs\
>
>     ii>git clone https://github.com/PuneethReddyHC/online-shopping-system-with-advanced-admin-page.git
>
> 4. extract files in C:\\xampp\htdocs\.
>
> 5. open link localhost/phpmyadmin
>
> 6. click on new at side navbar.
>
> 7. give a database name as (onlineshop) hit on create button.
>
> 8. after creating database name click on import.
>
> 9. browse the file in directory[online-shopping-system-with-advanced-admin-page/database/onlineshop.sql].
>
> 10. after importing successfully.
>
> 11. open any browser and type http://localhost/online-shopping-system-with-advanced-admin-page-master.
>
> 12. first register and then login
>
> 13. admin login details  Email=admin@gmail.com or username = admin and Password=123456789.
